bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import http.client,json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,os,shutil,sys
from tumblrkit.discovery_store import DiscoveryStore
from tumblrkit.media_save import MediaSave,Transcoder
print("ACTION=TUMBLR_MEDIA_REAL_OFFLINE_E2E")
try:
 root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
 tools=root/"dist"/"data"/"media-tools"
 for name in ("ffmpeg","ffprobe"):
  binary=tools/name
  assert binary.is_file() and binary.stat().st_mode & 0o077==0,"TOOL_UNAVAILABLE"
  assert subprocess.run([str(binary),"-version"],capture_output=True,timeout=15).returncode==0,"TOOL_BROKEN"
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=7)
 c.request("GET","/healthz");r=c.getresponse();status=r.status;health=json.loads(r.read(20000));c.close()
 assert status==200 and health.get("commit")=="ae2433c22d565c9b97f8649fc058dfc8a2feca45","WRONG_REVISION"
 for method,path in (("GET","/media/jobs"),("POST","/media/save"),("GET","/media/file/"+"0"*32)):
  c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=7);c.request(method,path);r=c.getresponse()
  assert r.status==401,"MISSING_OWNER_AUTH"
  r.read(100);c.close()
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="gace-media-offline-") as dirname:
  p=pathlib.Path(dirname);os.chmod(p,0o700)
  sample=p/"sample.avi"
  cmd=[str(tools/"ffmpeg"),"-hide_banner","-loglevel","error","-nostdin","-y",
       "-f","lavfi","-i","color=c=blue:s=160x90:r=5:d=1",
       "-c:v","mpeg4","-f","avi",str(sample)]
  subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,timeout=25,capture_output=True)
  assert sample.stat().st_size>0
  class OfflineDownloader:
   def probe(self,url):return sample.stat().st_size
   def fetch(self,url,dest,size):
    shutil.copyfile(sample,dest)
    return size
  store=DiscoveryStore(p/"candidate.sqlite3")
  store.save_page("tag:offline",[{"name":"sample","url":"https://sample.tumblr.com"}],
   [{"candidate_id":"sample:101","blog":"sample","post_id":"101",
    "url":"https://sample.tumblr.com/post/101","title":"local synthetic sample",
    "type":"video","date":"","thumbnail_url":"","text_excerpt":"",
    "tags":[],"note_count":0,
    "media_refs":[{"url":"https://64.media.tumblr.com/synthetic.mp4","type":"video"}]}],1,complete=True)
  media=p/"media";media.mkdir(mode=0o700)
  worker=MediaSave(store,media,OfflineDownloader(),Transcoder(str(tools/"ffprobe"),str(tools/"ffmpeg")))
  result=worker.save("sample:101",0,rights_confirmed=True)
  assert result["verified"] is True and result["state"]=="completed","MP4_JOB_FAILED"
  output=worker.file(result["job_id"])
  assert output.suffix==".mp4" and output.stat().st_size>0,"OUTPUT_MISSING"
  assert output.stat().st_mode & 0o077==0,"OUTPUT_PERMISSIONS"
  with open(output,"rb") as stream: assert b"ftyp" in stream.read(32),"OUTPUT_FORMAT"
  actual=Transcoder(str(tools/"ffprobe"),str(tools/"ffmpeg"))._probe(output)
  assert actual["video"]=="h264" and all(a=="aac" for a in actual["audio"]),"OUTPUT_CODEC"
  assert len(worker.list()["jobs"])==1 and worker.list()["jobs"][0]["source_post_id"]=="101","JOB_RECORD"
 print("REVISION=PASS")
 print("AUTH_GUARDS=PASS")
 print("PINNED_TOOLS=PASS")
 print("REAL_FFMPEG_MP4=PASS")
 print("SOURCE_OUTCOME_AUDIT=PASS")
 print("EXTERNAL_TUMBLR_CALLS=NONE")
 print("VERIFY=PASS")
except Exception as exc:
 print("VERIFY=FAIL")
 print("ERROR_TYPE="+type(exc).__name__)
 sys.exit(42)
PY
